$comment: Cue E of the score. Attrition across three stages.
title: The Long Road South

musical.notes: Cue D with the machinery removed: same key, three quarters of the tempo, one violin left holding the line. Instruments drop out and do not come back — attrition, not catastrophe.

provenance.prompt: Instrumental funeral march that keeps losing its step, 54 BPM, D minor. Solo violin, then solo clarinet, each carrying the three-note figure alone and tiring. Strings thin almost to nothing behind them. Long silences between phrases; the pulse falters and recovers. Exhausted, plain and unsentimental. No climax, no swell, no resolution.
provenance.excludes: percussion, vocals, choir, lush strings, orchestral swell, cinematic trailer, sentimental, uplifting

credit: Music: “The Long Road South”, generated with Suno for Sandtable, 2026.
notes: One cue for three stages — Lorraine, the Frontiers and the Great Retreat, roughly 20 August to 5 September. The longest stretch of the campaign, and it should feel like it will not end. Note that on 22 August the music is meant to stop entirely rather than play this or anything else.
